notes: Hard three-part scientific/numerics task (drawn from three gap competencies). (1) Per-peak lorentzian fitting: crop each peak's local window and fit center/width/amplitude/offset with scipy curve_fit using sane starting values and bounds; recovered parameters must match true values to tolerance on fresh hidden spectra. (2) Separability-matrix compositing: a symbolic (non-sampling, non-astropy-internal) routine must produce the correct 0/1 separability matrix for nested/stacked (blocked & permuted) compound astropy models, where a naive 'everything-couples' compositing is the exact failure an agent without the competency hits; verified against an independent numerical Jacobian ground-truth and astropy's own reference. (3) sqrt-Wasserstein: reduce the plan<middle-dot>cost to a scalar, root-clamp to non-negative, and square-root so the returned value is the actual metric distance, not the unrooted squared cost. Reasoning depth (3): deriving the boolearn-matrix composition (block diagonal for stacking, product for chaining, permutation selection for Mapping) without evaluating the model. Debugging ambiguity (2): the fit tolerances / overlapping-peak windows and the separability dimension bookkeeping are only stated at a high level. Adversarial inputs (2): overlapping peaks and a small/malformed spectrum tax detection, while separator and Wasserstein hidden cases include permutations, nested blocks, degenerate zero plans and negative costs. Hidden-case generalization (3): three-plus distinct hidden scenarios across all three deliverables must run unchanged on mounted fixtures. Quantitative correctness (3): fitted peak parameters and the Wasserstein value must match independent computations to tight tolerance. Difficulty floor is hard per competency C-4e2bd7bd (separability compositing).
